 At least 4 dead as gunmen open fire at Guwahati hotel 
 By
 TNM NewsDesk 
 ✓
 26 October 2026, 10:07 pm 
 1 min read
 26 Oct 2026 
 Gunmen open fire at Guwahati hotel 
 Four people were killed after unidentified gunmen opened fire at a group of six people near Hotel Bilas Inn in Guwahati’s Bora Service area on Monday evening, the Guwahati Commissioner of Police confirmed.
 According to media reports, the assailants targeted a group of six people, including two women, in a narrow lane adjacent to the hotel.

 Guwahati Commissioner of Police Partha Sarathi Mahanta, who rushed to the scene following the incident, confirmed that four bodies had been recovered.
 “This is a very unfortunate incident. Four bodies are recovered so far. While medical tests will confirm, they are visibly dead. People are investigating the matter. We will nab the culprits soon,” Mahanta said.
